sloka: अहं पञ्चसु भूतेषु मनष्षष्ठेषु राघव ।विचिन्त्य सीतां शुद्धेति जग्राह वननिर्झरे ।। ७.९६.२२ ॥
transliteration: ahaṁ pañcasu bhūteṣu manaṣṣaṣṭheṣu rāghava ।vicintya sītāṁ śuddheti jagrāha vananirjhare ।। 7.96.22 ॥

translations.english: O Raghava, I, who am present in the five elements and the mind as the sixth, accepted Sita as pure, having considered her in the forest stream.
